title: Question 5
stem: An analogue signal is to be transmitted as a digital signal.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State two advantages of the transmission of data in digital form rather than in analogue form.

markscheme_points.text: Any two suggestions: noise can be eliminated / signal can be regenerated; error correction bits can be added; data compression / multiplexing possible; signal encryption / improved security

hints: Hint 1: Focus on the physical mechanism in digital transmission that causes this behavior.
Hint 2: Rearrange the algebraic equation to isolate the target variable before substituting numerical values.

parts.part_stem:

On Fig. 5.1, sketch the signal produced by the DAC for time $t = 0$ to $t = 14\text{ ms}$.

each step has a width of 2 ms
